caption: Alla @cnbc questa mattina ho ribadito come i dazi di Trump non saranno un danno solo per l’economia europea e Italiana, ma colpiranno duramente anche quella americana.
text: There were some comments from the Prime Minister Giorgia Malone suggesting that tariffs could actually be an opportunity for Italy. Do you agree with that? No, unfortunately not, because we have an economy that has always been very strong on exports. So already the tariffs threatened by the US administration are impacting heavily our businesses and workers. Because since January, this level of uncertainty has been stopping the investments of our businesses. So this tariff at 30% would be a disaster for both the European and Italian economy. But I would add that it would be a disaster also for the American economy because you know that the EU and US relationship is very strong. We're talking about 1.7 trillion of exchange of trade. And if it's true that there is a trade deficit for the US with the EU on goods, it is not true on services in which we have the opposite situation. So the whole narrative of President Trump is based on a wrong assumption. We are strong on goods, weak on services. That's why I think that the EU and US should negotiate and find and reach a deal to prevent a trade war that would be a disaster for both our economies.
